format: UTF-8 RFC4180-style CSV with comma delimiter and JSON-escaped fields, gzip compressed

descriptions.api_call_json: Reconstructed method, endpoint, non-secret headers and original adapter body. Image bytes replaced with a SHA256-bound placeholder. Not an original wire log.
descriptions.api_response_json: Complete saved API response body, including served model and usage where returned. HTTP response headers were not recorded.
descriptions.record_json: Complete saved terminal record. Retains legacy task migration metadata and raw response. Parse to reconstruct the original response JSONL.
descriptions.benchmark_expected_answer: Logical FairLens target for this question, in canonical English. This is not a verified real-world attribute of the pictured person.
descriptions.input_image_sha256: SHA256 of exact padded PNG sent to both APIs.
descriptions.source_image_sha256: SHA256 of acquired cropped source image before RGB conversion and padding.
descriptions.race_label: Original dataset annotation for grouping, not a model prediction or self-identified demographic fact.
descriptions.eligible_unique_input: Global first official ID for a nonconflicting unique PNG. Paired/category analyses select first eligible pairs separately, so use the provided analysis code.
descriptions.selected_is_displayed_argmax: Whether returned category matches a maximum displayed score, accepting ties. Null for refusals.
descriptions.adverse_selected: 1 for benchmark adverse category, 0 for other supplied categories, null for refusal or no adverse target.
descriptions.soundness_match: 1 for expected category, 0 otherwise including an explicit refusal. Keeps every terminal task in the benchmark denominator.
descriptions.request_reconstructed: Always 1. Requests reconstructed from executed code and manifest. Authentication secrets and image bytes are excluded.

missing: Empty scalar or score cells denote not applicable or unavailable, never an imputed zero. JSON fields use null when no vector exists.
order: image_id, base question ID, language, model with Jev followed by GPT
row_unit: One official image entry × closed question × language × model
credentials: None included. The environment variable name identifies the credential to supply for a separately authorized future call.
api_call_note: Base64 placeholder is replaced with the locally reconstructed image whose hash matches input_image_sha256. Future hosted outputs may differ.
